scripts.text:
[Alberta Guide]
Welcome to Alberta,
the Port City. Feel free
to ask me if you're having
trouble finding anything in
town, or if you just need
guidance around the city.
scripts.translation:
[艾爾貝塔嚮導]
歡迎來到港口城市艾爾貝塔。
如果您找不到某個地方，或需要城內導覽，隨時可以問我。

scripts.text: City Guide
scripts.translation: 城市導覽

scripts.text: Remove Marks from Mini-Map
scripts.translation: 移除小地圖示記

scripts.text: Notice
scripts.translation: 告示

scripts.text:
[Alberta Guide]
Please select
a location from
the following menu.
Would you like me
to mark locations
on your Mini-Map?
scripts.translation:
[艾爾貝塔嚮導]
請從以下選單中選擇一個地點。
需要我在您的小地圖上標記位置嗎？

scripts.text:
[Alberta Guide]
Please select
a location from
the following menu.
scripts.translation:
[艾爾貝塔嚮導]
請從以下選單中選擇一個地點。

scripts.text:
[Alberta Guide]
Please select
a location from
the following menu.
[Alberta Guide]
The Merchant Guild
handles Job Changes
to the Merchant Class,
and is located in the
southwest corner
of Alberta.
scripts.translation:
[艾爾貝塔嚮導]
請從以下選單中選擇一個地點。
[艾爾貝塔嚮導]
商人公會負責辦理轉職成為商人的手續，位於艾爾貝塔的西南角。

scripts.text:
[Alberta Guide]
Please select
a location from
the following menu.
[Alberta Guide]
The Weapon Shop
can be found in the
southern end of Alberta.
scripts.translation:
[艾爾貝塔嚮導]
請從以下選單中選擇一個地點。
[艾爾貝塔嚮導]
武器店位於艾爾貝塔南端。

scripts.text:
[Alberta Guide]
Please select
a location from
the following menu.
[Alberta Guide]
The Tool Shop
is kind of close
to the center of
Alberta. It shouldn't
be too hard to find.
scripts.translation:
[艾爾貝塔嚮導]
請從以下選單中選擇一個地點。
[艾爾貝塔嚮導]
道具店就在艾爾貝塔中心附近，應該不難找。

scripts.text:
[Alberta Guide]
Please select
a location from
the following menu.
[Alberta Guide]
There's an Inn
at the northern
end of Alberta
where you can rest.
scripts.translation:
[艾爾貝塔嚮導]
請從以下選單中選擇一個地點。
[艾爾貝塔嚮導]
艾爾貝塔北端有一家旅館，您可以在那裡休息。

scripts.text:
[Alberta Guide]
Please select
a location from
the following menu.
[Alberta Guide]
The Forge in Alberta
is in the same building
as the Merchant Guild.
It's to the southwest.
scripts.translation:
[艾爾貝塔嚮導]
請從以下選單中選擇一個地點。
[艾爾貝塔嚮導]
鍛造所與商人公會在同一棟建築裡，位於艾爾貝塔西南方。

scripts.text:
[Alberta Guide]
Please select
a location from
the following menu.
[Alberta Guide]
Please ask me to ''Remove
Marks from Mini-Map'' if you
no longer wish to have the
location marks displayed
on your Mini-Map.
scripts.translation:
[艾爾貝塔嚮導]
請從以下選單中選擇一個地點。
[艾爾貝塔嚮導]
如果不想讓小地圖繼續顯示地點標記，請選擇“移除小地圖示記”。

scripts.text:
[Alberta Guide]
Advances in sorcery and
technology have allowed
us to update our information
system, enabling up to mark
locations on your Mini-Map
for easier navigation.
scripts.translation:
[艾爾貝塔嚮導]
魔法與科技的進步，讓我們得以更新資訊系統。
現在可以在您的小地圖上標記地點，讓您更容易找到路。

scripts.text:
[Alberta Guide]
Your Mini-Map is located
in the upper right corner
of the screen. If you can't
see it, press the Ctrl + Tab
keys or click the ''Map'' button in your Basic Info Window.
scripts.translation:
[艾爾貝塔嚮導]
小地圖位於螢幕右上角。
如果看不到，請按Ctrl + Tab，或點選基本資訊視窗中的“地圖”按鈕。

scripts.text:
[Alberta Guide]
On your Mini-Map,
click on the ''+'' and ''-''
symbols to zoom in and
our of your Mini-Map. We
hope you enjoy your travels
here in the city of Alberta.
scripts.translation:
[艾爾貝塔嚮導]
點選小地圖上的“+”和“-”，就能放大或縮小地圖。
祝您在艾爾貝塔旅行愉快。

scripts.text:
[Alberta Guide]
Be safe when you
travel and don't hesitate
to ask me if you have any
questions about Alberta.
scripts.translation:
[艾爾貝塔嚮導]
旅途中請注意安全。
對艾爾貝塔有任何疑問，儘管來問我。
